summary: Sony Group filed a 6-K attaching an English translation of its August 2026 Share Buyback Report submitted to the Kanto Finance Bureau, its US-equivalent open-market repurchase disclosure. Under the May 8, 2026 board authorization for up to 230,000,000 shares or ¥500bn through May 10, 2027, Sony bought 11,613,200 shares for ¥43.48bn on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during August via a discretionary trading contract. Cumulative repurchases reached 67,581,300 shares for ¥237.35bn, or 29.38% of authorized shares and 47.47% of authorized value. Monthly dispositions of 3,140,694 shares included acquisition-right exercises and restricted stock. Watch buyback pace against the ¥500bn cap.
